/practicalAccordionItems/0/title.source_en: Pickup, drop-off and how the hours are counted

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/0.source_en: Pickup is at your accommodation anywhere in central Busan — Seomyeon, Haeundae, Nampo-dong, Busan Station and the surrounding districts — at a start time you choose. Outlying areas are usually fine; we confirm at booking.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/1.source_en: Your booked hours start at the confirmed pickup time and end at drop-off, not at the first or last sightseeing stop. Driving between stops is part of the day.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/2.source_en: Drop-off is anywhere in Busan: back at your hotel, at a different hotel if you are moving on, at Busan Station, or at a restaurant for the evening.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/3.source_en: Gimhae International Airport pickup or drop-off is available as a paid add-on — see the add-ons section.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/preview.source_en: Pickup is at your accommodation anywhere in central Busan — Seomyeon, Haeundae, Nampo-dong, Busan Station and the surrounding districts — at a start time you choose. Outlying areas are usually fine; we confirm at booking.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/0.source_en: One price per vehicle, not per person: 5 hours US$160 · 6 hours US$185 · 7 hours US$205 · 8 hours US$225 · 9 hours US$255, for 1 to 7 guests.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/1.source_en: A group of one pays the same as a group of seven — the charge is for the car and the driver-guide, so the more of you there are, the less it costs each.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/2.source_en: 8 guests or more need a second vehicle, and the price is simply twice the figure above for the same number of hours.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/3.source_en: Time beyond 9 hours is charged per extra hour and is subject to driver availability — please ask at booking rather than on the day.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/preview.source_en: One price per vehicle, not per person: 5 hours US$160 · 6 hours US$185 · 7 hours US$205 · 8 hours US$225 · 9 hours US$255, for 1 to 7 guests.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/0.source_en: Gimhae Airport pickup or drop-off adds US$35. A Gyeongju day adds US$55. Each hour past 9 adds US$35.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/1.source_en: Airport transfer: useful on an arrival or departure day — collect your luggage, spend the day in Busan, and finish at the airport instead of doubling back to a hotel.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/2.source_en: Gyeongju: the old Silla capital is about 70 minutes from Busan by road. Added to a charter it becomes a full day out — Bulguksa, the royal tombs at Daereungwon, and Hwangnidan-gil — and needs 9 hours or more to be worth doing.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/3.source_en: All add-ons are arranged at booking so the driver's day is planned around them.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/preview.source_en: Gimhae Airport pickup or drop-off adds US$35. A Gyeongju day adds US$55. Each hour past 9 adds US$35.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/0.source_en: The three routes are starting points, not fixed products. Add, drop, reorder or replace any stop.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/1.source_en: Send changes at booking or any time up to 24 hours before, and the driver-guide confirms a revised order and tells you honestly what will and will not fit.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/2.source_en: On the day, the order can still shift for weather, crowds or simply because everyone wants to stay somewhere longer.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/3.source_en: Changing the route does not change the price. What you pay is set by the number of hours and the number of vehicles, not by where you go.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/preview.source_en: The three routes are starting points, not fixed products. Add, drop, reorder or replace any stop.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/0.source_en: Sedan or SUV for 1 to 3 guests; a mid-size van for 4 to 7. The vehicle is yours alone — no other bookings share it.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.source_en: Drivers are licensed, insured and speak English. Chinese-speaking drivers can usually be requested at booking; other languages depend on availability.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.source_en: Child seats can be arranged free of charge if you tell us the ages when you book.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/3.source_en: Luggage is fine for airport transfers, but a full van of guests plus a full set of large cases will not fit — tell us the case count and we will send the right vehicle.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/preview.source_en: Sedan or SUV for 1 to 3 guests; a mid-size van for 4 to 7. The vehicle is yours alone — no other bookings share it.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/title.source_en: What is included and what you pay directly

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/0.source_en: Included: private vehicle and driver-guide for your group only · pickup and drop-off in Busan · tolls, parking and fuel · booking fee.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.source_en: Not included: entrance fees and ride tickets at the stops you choose · meals and drinks · the Sky Capsule ticket on Route 2 · personal expenses · gratuities · travel insurance.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.source_en: Entrance fees on these routes are modest and several of the best stops are free — Gamcheon and Dakbatgol villages, the ⟦G0⟧, Haeundae Beach, the markets and the Songdo skywalk all cost nothing to enter.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/3.source_en: Your driver-guide can queue and pay on your behalf where that is faster, and you settle in cash on the day.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/preview.source_en: Included: private vehicle and driver-guide for your group only · pickup and drop-off in Busan · tolls, parking and fuel · booking fee.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/title.source_en: Surcharges, cancellation and who this charter is for

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/0.source_en: Out-of-hours surcharge: a start before 07:00 or a finish after 20:00 adds a per-hour surcharge, paid on the day.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/1.source_en: Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the charter starts. Inside 24 hours the booking is non-refundable.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/2.source_en: Destinations outside Busan other than Gyeongju are quoted separately — ask before booking.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/3.source_en: This charter suits groups who want to decide their own day. If you would rather be told where to go and pay less, our join-in Busan day tours cover Routes 1 and 3 at a per-person price.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/preview.source_en: Out-of-hours surcharge: a start before 07:00 or a finish after 20:00 adds a per-hour surcharge, paid on the day.
